question: Which of the following rivers originates from the Himalayas?
solution:
**The correct answer is 'Ganga'**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__**

__
 
• **Ganga River:**

 
 
• The Ganga originates from the **Gangotri Glacier** in the Himalayas at **Gaumukh**, in Uttarakhand.
 
• It is one of the major Himalayan rivers, perennial in nature due to snowmelt and rainfall.
 
• The river flows through northern India and Bangladesh, supporting agriculture, culture, and livelihoods across the Indo-Gangetic plain.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__

 
• **Godavari River:**

 
 
• Originates from **Trimbakeshwar** in Maharashtra (Western Ghats).
 
• It is the longest river of Peninsular India but does not originate in the Himalayas.
 
 
 
• **Tapi River:**
 
 
• Originates from the **Satpura Hills** in Madhya Pradesh.
 
• Flows westward into the Arabian Sea, not Himalayan in origin.
 
 
 
• **Narmada River:**
 
 
• Originates from the **Amarkantak Plateau** in Madhya Pradesh.
 
• It is a major west-flowing peninsular river but not from the Himalayas.
